title: 2HRZE/4HR — the six-month spine
dek: Isoniazid, rifampin, pyrazinamide, ethambutol for two months, then HR for four. Still the WHO default DS-TB regimen and the grammar every four-month alternative is measured against.
story: Standard drug-susceptible pulmonary TB remains 2 months of isoniazid (H), rifampin/rifampicin (R), pyrazinamide (Z), and ethambutol (E), then 4 months of HR. The intensive phase covers high-burden replicating populations (INH) and lesions (PZA) while EMB guards against undetected resistance; the continuation phase is sterilizing rifamycin plus INH.

WHO 2024–2025 still lists 2HRZE/4HR as a core option. The 4-month HPMZ regimen (tb-hpzm) and the SHINE 4-month regimen for non-severe pediatric TB (tb-shine) are alternatives for eligible people, not a reason to forget why six months existed: relapse from persisters when you drop the rifamycin too soon.

HIV: treat TB at least as long as in HIV-negative people; ART timing is a separate clock (tb-hiv-art). Pregnancy: WHO uses HRZE including PZA; CDC historically hesitated on PZA and has moved closer to WHO — stamp the overlay, do not mix them silently. Meningitis and bone/joint disease still often need longer and different companions.
deepTitle: Doses, FDC, and when the mnemonic breaks
deep: Adults: INH 5 mg/kg (max 300 mg), RIF 10 mg/kg (max 600 mg), PZA 25 mg/kg, EMB 15 mg/kg — WHO weight bands via FDC tablets. Children have higher mg/kg bands (INH 10 mg/kg-class, RIF 15 mg/kg-class).
Ethambutol can be dropped in the continuation phase when DS is confirmed. It is a companion, not a sterilizing star.
Intermittent dosing in continuation is largely a historical CDC overlay; daily dosing is the WHO default.
If RIF is lost, this mnemonic is over. Do not “continue HRZE without R.” That is how you invent MDR in public.

steps.title: Do not freelance a four-month drop unless eligible
steps.body: If they do not meet HPMZ criteria (age, drug-susceptible, pulmonary), six months is not “old-fashioned.” It is on-label WHO.

check.why: 5 × 70 = 350, then cap at 300 mg for the usual adult tablet strength.

whyWrong.350 mg: Uncapped arithmetic; programmes cap at 300 mg.
